text: The invariant time elapsed on a clock carried along a worldline, given by dτ = √(−ds²)/c = dt/γ, is called the ___ time.
explanation: Proper time dτ = √(−ds²)/c = dt√(1−v²/c²) is measured by a co-moving clock and is frame-independent — all observers agree on its value. It is distinct from coordinate time t, which depends on the frame. The straight (inertial) worldline between two events maximizes proper time.
